name: After § 25
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 25b. Welcomes the arrest warrants issued by the International Criminal Court on 21 November 2024 for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, former Defence Minister Yoav Gallant and Hamas leader Mohammed Deif; reminds the EU and its Member States that this decision is binding on all EU Member States by virtue of the Rome Statute to which they are party and that is part of the EU* acquis*;
